title: macOS overlay
what: The always-on-top Swift panel that hosts the live page on macOS, built into an app by its build script (macos/main.swift, macos/build.sh).

title: Live and demo pages
what: The browser pages the daemon serves: the live table that follows the event stream and shows the sessions of the window, and the demo page of fixed sample rows (web/index.html, web/demo.html).
